title: OpenAPI / Swagger docs for Next.js App Router
implementationState: Stages 0-6 implemented locally; independent review and hosted gate evidence pending
implementationNotes: 42 registered product paths (auth/jobs/payments/shop). Admin/webhook/cron/internal excluded. Drift guard: npm run check:openapi-drift.

independentReview.scope: Review stage criteria; confirm no protected business-logic changes and no secret leakage in the OpenAPI document.

requirements.expectation: All src/app/api route handlers are inventoried into buckets with Stage 2-5 domain targets listed.
Docs access policy and Zod 4 OpenAPI bridge choice recorded.
Server-only OpenAPI registry with ok/fail envelopes and security stubs; protected logic unchanged.
requirements.verification: document.test.ts envelope components; protected greps clean in this diff

requirements.expectation: GET /api/openapi returns parseable OpenAPI 3 when enabled; denied when disabled.
Swagger UI at /api/docs only when enabled; production default off.
OpenAPI document and docs UI do not embed env secrets or provider keys.
requirements.verification: Generated document uses schemas/examples without env values; x-ona-inventory is structural only

requirements.expectation: Core auth routes documented; login/OTP share Zod with handlers.
Product job routes documented; sweeps omitted from public Swagger.
Product payment routes documented; Flutterwave webhook excluded from try-it-out.
requirements.verification: document.test.ts asserts webhook path absent; paths/payments.ts

requirements.expectation: Customer-facing shop API routes documented; admin shop omitted.
Script fails when a registered OpenAPI path has no matching route.ts; residuals listed.
Non-production host can enable docs; production remains gated/off unless explicitly enabled.

code.item: Optionally extract remaining inline Zod from jobs/payments/shop/auth handlers into shared modules (login/OTP already shared).
Messages, notifications, profile, express and other authenticated product routes remain residual.
Swagger UI currently loads swagger-ui-dist@5.17.14 from unpkg; self-host if CDN policy requires.

external.item: Enable OPENAPI_DOCS_ENABLED on a non-production host and record sanitized reachability; confirm production default remains off.
